<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Helps avoid false dependencies on undef registers by updating the machine instructions' undef operand to use a register that the instruction is truly dependent on, or use a register with clearance higher than Pref.</p>


<p>Returns true if it was able to find a true dependency, thus not requiring a dependency breaking instruction regardless of clearance.</p>

<p>Walk the block backward computing precise liveness. This is expensive, so we only do it on demand. Note that the occurrence of undefined register reads that should be broken is very rare, but when they occur we may have many in a single block.</p>
